text.unicode_limit: Optical punctuation reading does not authenticate underlying raster text encoding.

style.observed: Continuous grayscale everyday door photograph; no ominous corridor or antique-store arrangement.

substantive_visual.observed: Substantial installed lever, cylinder and inserted key remain clearly visible at usage and thumbnail sizes.

hangul.observed: Open counters, normal proportions, no evident copy omission or distortion.

information_relationship.observed: Left guide column descends alongside the lower key; title below grip persists.

function_contact.observed: Mount/spindle and cylinder/key-neck relation remain visible; local key wear remains weaker than intended.

material_edge_finish.observed: No clear object halo; same upper-left light and short shadows. Coarser key scratches and lever pits remain concrete limits.

located_observations.observation: Both attachments remain grounded on the same door and the key enters the keyhole with its teeth hidden.
All seven supplied entries remain legible and grouped; no added labels, logo or footer strip are visible.
Title/guide counters and syllable proportions remain open and ordinary. Word spaces are visible; date and operating dashes read as horizontal range marks.
The large lever and lower key remain a substantive recognizable scene; title is still subordinate in height to the grip rather than beside it.
Grayscale and light direction remain consistent; door paint texture is somewhat more coarse and contrasty than initial.

residuals.observation: The center remains filled with crossing scratch-like marks. The outer rim is brighter, but broad face distress remains.
residuals.impact: Local grasp-rim wear still does not separate cleanly from general wear.

residuals.observation: The lever tip shifts slightly right but remains in the left text region. Title starts beneath the grip and its final first-line glyph approaches the lever underside.
residuals.impact: Requested title-at-grip adjacency is still absent; gap has narrowed.

residuals.observation: Grip is thicker and its dark pits/scratch marks remain pronounced within the bright patch.
residuals.impact: Metal is visually rougher than the desired quiet localized smoothing.

residuals.observation: The small information remains too small for comfortable full reading at 213×320; readable at usage720.

decision: Use last permitted repair for title/lever adjacency and quieter key-center/lever-grip surfaces; preserve clear copy and actual installation relationship.
